blocks.orig: The Gran Meliá Arusha is an oasis set out on 18 acres of beautifully landscaped coffee and tea plantations, with spectacular views of Mount Meru. All rooms of the hotel are equipped with private balconies overlooking Arusha town or Mount Meru, 65-inch TVs, air-conditioning and free Wi-Fi.
blocks.html: Surrounded by 18 acres of coffee and tea plantations with beautiful landscaping, the Gran Meliá Arusha is an oasis that looks out on Mount Meru. Each room comes with its own balcony facing either Mount Meru or Arusha town, plus a 65-inch TV, air-conditioning and free Wi-Fi.

blocks.orig: A wellness centre, spa, outside pool and rooftop terrace elevate your experience, while you can enjoy fresh cuisine at the Saba Saba restaurant, or submerge yourself in a different kind of Indian cuisine at Yellow Chilli. To end the day on a literal high note, you head to the top floor where you find incredible views of Mount Meru, a bar and a restaurant serving Peruvian-Spanish fusion cuisine. Make sure to be there where the sun sets, sundowner in hand, as your safari can hardly start or end in a better way.
blocks.html: There is a wellness centre and spa, a pool outside and a terrace on the roof to make your stay extra special. For a meal you can enjoy fresh dishes at the Saba Saba restaurant, or discover a different side of Indian cooking at Yellow Chilli. End the day on a literal high note on the top floor, which has a bar, a restaurant with a Peruvian-Spanish fusion menu and incredible views of Mount Meru. Make sure you are there at sunset with a sundowner, because it is hard to think of a better start or finish to your safari.
